summary: Focused regression on two new features: (1) smart profession search with 'did you mean' suggestions; (2) Referências section with consent gate. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS (test_new_features.py). Frontend Playwright validated all required testids and interactions. Admin payment settings NOT touched (published flag not modified).
critical_code_review_comments: sanitize_references (server.py:152) correctly nukes name/phone/email/company/role when consent is false — defensive write path on both POST and PUT drafts. Good.

list_professions (server.py:228) only emits suggestions when exact match list is empty — matches spec; threshold 0.65 in _similar_professions returns 'Electricista' for 'electrisista' (and also 'Técnico de Electrónica' due to token overlap) — acceptable.

ReferencesForm hides inputs behind consent checkbox (ref-locked-N visible before, inputs removed from DOM) — ref-name-0 is absent until consent, matching spec. Unchecking clears data (verified: name/phone become empty on re-check).

Review page (/rever/:token) renders toggle-references only when refs have at least one item with data (not visible when empty), and does not block Finalizar — the Finalizar validation only requires personal name + phone.
No ObjectId leaks observed; drafts endpoints already project {_id:0}.
